items.question: Under what condition must a hundred-thousand measure situated at the forehead-syllable mass, once accomplished, be offered in the context of god-worship?
premises: A measure situated at the forehead-syllable mass is designated for a specific offering.
A hundred-thousand count forms the required quantity for that offering.
Once the prescribed act has been accomplished, that measure belongs to god-worship.
items.inference: The hundred-thousand measure located at the forehead-syllable mass, having been accomplished, is to be assigned to what is worshipped by the gods.
uncertainties: The precise ritual role of the forehead-syllable mass remains unclear from this verse alone.
items.plain_english: The hundred-thousand measure situated at the mass of forehead syllables, once the act is done, belongs to the god-worshipped offering.
